name: cypherengine
description: Pinned third-party dependency graph for CypherEngine runtime, tests, and tools.

archive-tools.description: ZIP import and export support for tools; CypherPak remains the runtime archive format.

asset-import-fallback.description: Broad tools-only model import fallback when focused importers are insufficient.

audio.description: Runtime spatial audio, Opus streams and voice, and tools-side source audio decoding.

editor-support.description: Database and native-dialog support for non-Qt tools and editor services.

image-import.description: Tools-side import of PNG, JPEG, and EXR source images.

math.description: GLM-backed implementation support for the future CypherMath library.

mesh-pipeline.description: Mesh optimization support; cgltf and MikkTSpace are pinned source dependencies.

networking.description: HTTPS services and an optional GameNetworkingSockets transport backend.

scripting.description: Lua gameplay and tool scripting runtime.

security.description: Enables the core libsodium-backed CypherSecurity subsystem.

shader-tools.description: Offline GLSL-to-SPIR-V compilation, validation, optimization, and reflection support.

text.description: Font rasterization and international text shaping.

texture-pipeline.description: KTX2 and Basis Universal texture processing for cooked Cypher textures.
